verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since other clouds offer on-prem or hybrid editions, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a managed Kubernetes service running on CoreWeave's own bare-metal infrastructure in CoreWeave Cloud. Nothing shows a self-hostable or on-prem distribution of the core product. Terraform and API control of CoreWeave-hosted resources is remote management, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
